question: Can a positive-definite one-parameter tidal-response mapping survive galaxy and cluster amplitude tests before full 3-D PDE reconstruction?

validation.training_objective: equal weight to mean complete-system squared log10 residual in SPARC and CLASH
validation.one_kappa: one value per formula family and gate power, shared by every galaxy and cluster

claim_boundary: This is a spherical radial eigenvalue proxy, not a solution of the full anisotropic field equation.
SPARC nuisance values were previously fitted under fixed RAR and therefore favor the RAR comparator.
The CLASH target is NFW-deprojected rather than a raw image or shear likelihood.
Failure of every nonlinear mapping would retire this spherical proxy but not prove that full 3-D field-line redistribution is impossible.
